This stack allows creators to maintain full ownership of their sales and customer data while minimizing transaction costs. With services like NOWPayments, creators can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, ensuring low fees—only 0.5% compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This shift not only enhances profitability but also empowers creators with greater control over their business operations.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The foundation of an independent online store for selling beats hinges on several integrated components. Utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, alongside Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, provides a robust and scalable framework. Supabase or Google Sheets can serve as order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handles product file delivery. Finally, NOWPayments ensures seamless crypto payment processing, firing webhooks instantly upon payment confirmation. This architecture is designed for creators to operate with sovereignty and reliability.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are ineffective or restricted. Whether you’re a musician, a producer, or a sound designer looking to sell beats, this architecture provides the necessary tools to create a fully operational online store. The target audience includes creators from Nigeria, Ghana, Venezuela, and similar markets, who need a sustainable way to monetize their work without incurring excessive platform fees.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this independent selling infrastructure include free hosting platforms like GitHub Pages, which provide reliable uptime for your store. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script facilitate backend operations, ensuring that transactions and product deliveries occur smoothly. For order management, Supabase or Google Sheets can be utilized, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that your digital products are delivered instantly. Finally, NOWPayments integrates effortlessly for crypto transactions, making this stack both effective and efficient.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this infrastructure for selling beats online, start by setting up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account. Next, configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Choose a data storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure your digital products are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. For a comprehensive guide and templates, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to build and scale your digital commerce stack.

This method allows you to bypass traditional payment systems while maintaining full ownership of your sales. By setting up your store using a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell directly to customers without incurring high platform fees.

It provides all necessary blueprints and templates to establish your independent digital store. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
